name: Weak
overview: Scripture acknowledges human weakness, especially in the flesh, as seen in Jesus' warning that the spirit is willing but the flesh is weak (Matthew 26:41). Believers are called to support those who are weak (Acts 20:35) and to exercise patience, trusting that waiting on the Lord will renew their strength and enable them to persevere without fainting (Isaiah 40:31). The Spirit also aids believers in their weaknesses by interceding on their behalf when they do not know how to pray (Romans 8:26). This divine assistance empowers Christians to seek God's kingdom first (Matthew 6:33) and to act justly toward the afflicted and needy (Psalms 82:3).
